kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-notification-configurations --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNotificationConfigurations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

NotificationConfigurationModel.description_en: The collection of auto scaling events and resource change notifications
NotificationConfigurationModel.description_zh: 弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知的集合

MessageEncoding.description_en:
The encoding method of the notification content. Valid values:

PlainText: no encoding. The notification is sent in plaintext.
Base64: Base64 encoding
MessageEncoding.description_zh:
消息通知内容的编码方式。可能值：

PlainText：不编码，采用明文传输。
Base64：Base64 编码

NotificationArn.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the notification recipient. The following formats are supported:

CloudMonitor: acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor.
MNS queue: acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}.
MNS topic: acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}.

The variables in the formats have the following meanings:
region-id: The region ID of the scaling group.
account-id: The Alibaba Cloud account ID.
queuename: The name of the MNS queue.
topicname: The name of the MNS topic
NotificationArn.description_zh:
通知对象标识符，参数格式如下：

云监控：acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor。
MNS队列：acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}。
MNS主题：acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：
region-id：伸缩组所在的地域的ID。
account-id：阿里云账号ID。
queuename：MNS队列的名称。
topicname：MNS主题的名称

items.description_en: The list of auto scaling event and resource change notification types
items.description_zh: 弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知类型列表

ScalingGroupId.description_en: The ID of the scaling group

TimeZone.description_en: The time zone of the notification. The time zone offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), such as UTC+8 or UTC-7
TimeZone.description_zh:
消息通知的时区。
时区相对于协调世界时的偏移量： 如 UTC+8（东八区）、UTC-7（西七区）等
